origin: Independent frozen original C API runs and original GGUF writer/scalar quantizers; no Rust expected values.

tiny-inputs/contract-before-rust.json.graph: BLOOM fixed max ALiBi bias8, contiguous F32 cache, one thread, nonflash, F32 activation/vector operations. Any failing comparison must be diagnosed before changing the contract.

pretrained-contract-before-rust.json.source_semantics: F32 causal contiguous KV; native CPU one thread, nonflash, embedding and affine norms, fixed ALiBi max bias 8. Native captured values only; investigate source arithmetic differences before any contract change.

packing: Finite JSON numbers round-trip to the same F32 words, little endian; deduplicate only full byte-identical rows using SHA-256 plus byte equality.
scope: Strict causal contiguous F32-cache BLOOM decoder; F32/F16/BF16/Q4_0/Q8_0/Q4_K tiny variants and untouched official BLOOM560m F16/Q8_0 trained checkpoints. No native compatibility C context, flash, other cache types, per-layer arrays or noncausal execution claim.
